intro.text: One of the bridge crews of Highprince Sadeas's army, notorious for its bad luck and for losing the most men on bridge runs.
A crew of former bridgemen led by Kaladin, freed from Sadeas's army to serve as Dalinar Kholin's honor guard.

A group led by Kaladin Stormblessed, a Windrunner, that began as a bridge crew in Sadeas's warcamp. It went on to guard Dalinar Kholin and then became mostly Kaladin's squires, yet kept its old name and its bridge.

description.text: Being sent to Bridge Four was used as a punishment, and its plight helped keep the other crews in line. Knowing nothing worse could happen to them, its men made no effort and didn't even share their names.
As Dalinar's guard, the men refused to count themselves part of the Cobalt Guard: they cut its insignia off their uniforms and had it replaced with Bridge Four's own.
The freed men had their slave brands covered with tattoos of freedom. Hobber asked for a Bridge Four glyph to be added, and the rest followed, even those without brands.
After Kaladin spoke the Third Ideal, members began becoming his squires, gaining Stormlight and Lashings. Dalinar then thought them too important for guard duty and gave it to other bridge crews.

The crew trained in Surgebinding, recruited possible squires and took on vital missions for Dalinar. Their powers faded when Kaladin was far away, so Dalinar gave them the Windrunner Honorblade to train with.

items.text: Kaladin forced Gaz to make him Bridge Four's bridgeleader, with full control of the crew, and began learning his men's names.
Kaladin's training slowly won the crew over, until every member followed him out each morning to exercise and drill with their bridge.
On one assault Kaladin had the crew carry their bridge on its side, which kept them all alive but left the other bridges exposed; the assault failed and Kaladin was beaten as punishment.
While Kaladin was strung up in the highstorm, members of the crew came to him and vowed they would not go back to how they had been.
Under Kaladin, Bridge Four came through its bridge approaches without losing a man.
Despite its gains, the crew was treated even worse by the warcamp's officers, and Kaladin began planning an escape for all of them.
Giving up their chance to escape, Kaladin and the crew went back to rescue Highprince Dalinar Kholin and his army.

Dalinar gave Sadeas his Shardblade in exchange for the freedom of every bridgeman in the warcamp. Bridge Four became Dalinar's honor guard, with Kaladin as captain of the guard and of a new battalion of former bridgemen.
Skar and Moash were tasked with the crew's bodyguard duties.
Teft and Lopen bonded honorspren and became Knights Radiant.
Teft, having reached the Third Ideal, took squires of his own from Bridge Thirteen.
